name: Sud
source:
A youth from the surface world who in order to help his allies who are suffering due to how polluted the air is sets off to reach Neosphere along with [url=/c48270]Atharva[/url].
After [url=/c48267]Eve[/url] saves his life he promises to show her the 'sky'.

A strong but kind guy who is good at surviving.
